title: FactRecord
description: Factual extraction schema with unit, currency, period, accounting basis, and source-span verification (C2-R04)

fact_id.description: Unique identifier for this extracted fact record

issuer_id.description: Standardized canonical issuer ticker (e.g. NVDA, AMD, MSFT)

metric.description: Financial or operational metric name (e.g. REVENUE, CAPEX, DATA_CENTER_REVENUE, OPERATING_INCOME)

raw_value_text.description: Exact text string as extracted from the source document snippet

value.description: Raw unscaled numerical value. Missing/unknown value MUST be null, never coerced to 0.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. USD, PERCENT, RATIO, SHARES)

currency.description: ISO currency code (e.g. USD). Non-USD requires explicit conversion policy.

normalized_usd.description: Normalized USD amount as stringified Decimal or number. Null if value is null.

period_type.description: Cadence classification to prevent conflation of annual and quarterly figures

basis.description: Accounting basis. Merging or comparing GAAP with NON_GAAP is prohibited.

source_id.description: Identifier of the verified registered source filing

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the source filing

span_start.description: 0-indexed character start offset within source text

span_end.description: 0-indexed character end offset within source text

source_snippet.description: Excerpted sentence or table row from which the fact was extracted

is_revised.description: True if this fact is from an amended filing (10-K/A or 10-Q/A)

supersedes_fact_id.description: Identifier of the previous unrevised fact this record restates

revision_number.description: Filing revision counter (1 for initial, 2 for first amendment)

quality_flags.description: Verification flags (e.g. SPAN_VERIFIED, RESTATED, UNKNOWN_VALUE, GAAP_VERIFIED)
